open_points.subject: bearer_credential
open_points.text: bearer_credential: [SECURITY_BOUNDARY] MUST return the token part of the request's single Authorization header whose value is the scheme Bearer, compared without regard to case, followed by exactly one space and a non-empty token, and MUST raise AuthenticationRequired when the header is absent, appears more than once, or has any other form; it MUST NOT read the body or the path parameters.
open_points.other_text: Use only the IMPORTS listed above plus required standard library imports.
open_points.question: AuthenticationRequired must either be added to IMPORTS or replaced with an available exception.

open_points.subject: check_token
open_points.text: check_token: [SECURITY_BOUNDARY] MUST compare the presented credential with the service token whole, case-sensitively and in constant time with hmac.compare_digest over their UTF-8 bytes, return None when they are equal, and raise AuthenticationRequired otherwise; a matching token authorizes the one principal of the service, the calling flow of the owner, for every confirmed connection, and it MUST NOT log or return either value.
open_points.other_text: Use only the IMPORTS listed above plus required standard library imports.
open_points.question: AuthenticationRequired must either be added to IMPORTS or replaced with an available exception.

open_points.subject: deliver_route
open_points.text: deliver_route: [ORCHESTRATION] MUST be defined async, check the token as scan_route does before anything else, then await the request body once and pass it to _deliver_request and the path project id to _project_id, then run the imported deliver_project_photo with the context held in the application state and the name and source_id of the request through starlette run_in_threadpool, because the project lock it takes waits without a time limit, and MUST answer with a JSONResponse holding the JSON form of the PlacementOutcome it returns and its default success status, whatever its status; AuthenticationRequired and DelivererError MUST be answered as in scan_route.
open_points.other_text: Use only the IMPORTS listed above plus required standard library imports.
open_points.question: AuthenticationRequired must either be added to IMPORTS or removed or replaced in this handling requirement.

open_points.other_text: Use only the IMPORTS listed above plus required standard library imports.

open_points.subject: scan_route
open_points.text: scan_route: [ORCHESTRATION] MUST call check_token with the token held in the application state and the credential bearer_credential takes from the request, then _project_id with the path project id, then the imported scan_project_photos with the context held in the application state, and MUST answer with a JSONResponse holding the JSON form of the ScanResult it returns and its default success status; AuthenticationRequired MUST be answered by _refusal_answer with the UNAUTHORIZED member of = models.RefusalCode and DelivererError by _refusal_answer with the code it carries. It is a plain function, so the framework runs it in its thread pool, and it MUST NOT read the body.
